Name: Espurr Pokemon as Cat
Author: Vistiie
Description:
[size=4][b][u]What is in the File?[/u][/b][/size]
It is just a PNG. that is meant to replace the default cat. However, you can rename it to replace any of the various cat sprites.[i] Read step 3 on How to Download.
[/i]
It requires another mod to use for now, but I might update this with its own code in the future. 
 
[size=4][b][u]How to Download:[/u][/b][/size]
[size=2][1] (HIGHLY RECOMMEND) Download[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4764?tab=description] DIY Pets CP[/url]: This mod is 1.6 updated and makes swapping around portraits for custom pets super easy[/size]
[2] Download this mod 
[3] Unzip the file to find and place "cat.png" into [CP] DIY Pet Replacer\assets and replace the file that's already in there. OR rename this mod's file to be any of the other cat variants such as "cat1.png", "cat2.png", etc. 
[4] You can delete the empty files afterwards

[b][size=4][u]Description:[/u][/size][/b]
Espurr is awesome! How has there not been a dedicated Espurr mod already created? Well... technically [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2529]StravaJD's [/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2529]Pokefy [/url]got there first, but Espurr was buried under the spoilers (with no images) and not very easily findable (I didn't think there was an Espurr mod for months)..

As it turns out, the sprites (for Espurr) come from the Pokemon Mystery Dungeon games which happen to have a [url=https://sprites.pmdcollab.org/]PMD Sprite Repository[/url]! (I'll talk about this more in the [b]Credits [/b]section). 

It's not much at all, but I made some personal preference tweaks (color, expression, poses) to the Espurr sprites and swapped out many animation frames for other ones in the repository. Also, a mod with Espurr titled in it hopefully makes it a lot easier for anyone looking for specific Espurr pet sprites LOL! Please enjoy.
